name: @bongtu/wallet-web
description: bongtu consumer wallet — the self-scan P2P wallet (issue #13): connect any installed extension (EIP-6963) or WalletConnect through the RainbowKit modal (wagmi v2 + viem), derive a BabyJubJub spending key from an eth_signTypedData_v4 signature (deterministic), and discover balance + activity by scanning the PUBLIC feed with the wallet's own keys (OPMOD §3.6 self-scan against a public-mode indexer) — tokenless by construction, with no institutional read path reachable from the app code (dead view-token bytes still ride the shared engine until the login default deps split). The 4 consumer ops (depositPriv/transferPriv/transfer10x2Priv/withdrawPriv) prove in-browser and submit to the registered op modules. Imports unbuilt @bongtu/* workspace source directly so the crypto is byte-identical.
